prompt: What is the title of the second YouTube video ever uploaded?
answer:
The second video generally recognized as uploaded to YouTube was **“My Snowboarding Skillz”**, uploaded by user **“mw”** shortly after **“Me at the zoo”** on April 23, 2005. It shows someone attempting—and failing—to snowboard over a ramp.

Some later sources mention Jawed Karim’s now-removed **“Rolling down a hill,”** but surviving upload records generally place it third, after “My Snowboarding Skillz.”
